mapper.select: SELECT st.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.member_id IS NOT NULL AND m.create_time >= #{bo.startDate} AND m.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{bo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN m.member_id END), 0) AS newMemberCount, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cr.checkin_id IS NOT NULL AND cr.checkin_status = 'success' AND cr.checkin_time >= #{bo.startDate} AND cr.checkin_time < DATE_ADD(#{bo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN cr.member_id END), 0) AS activeMemberCount, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_id IS NOT NULL AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'refunded') AND o.paid_time >= #{bo.startDate} AND o.paid_time < DATE_ADD(#{bo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN o.member_id END), 0) AS paidMemberCount, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mc.card_id IS NOT NULL AND mc.card_status IN ('unused', 'active') AND mc.active_time >= #{bo.startDate} AND mc.active_time < DATE_ADD(#{bo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN mc.card_id END), 0) AS activeCardCount, IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mc.card_id IS NOT NULL AND mc.card_status IN ('unused', 'active') AND mc.expire_time IS NOT NULL AND mc.expire_time >= NOW() AND mc.expire_time < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN mc.card_id END), 0) AS expiringCardCount FROM fit_store st LEFT JOIN fit_member m ON m.home_store_id = st.store_id AND m.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_checkin_record cr ON cr.store_id = st.store_id AND cr.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_order o ON o.store_id = st.store_id AND o.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member_card mc ON mc.store_id = st.store_id AND mc.del_flag = '0' WHERE st.del_flag = '0' AND st.store_id = #{bo.storeId} GROUP BY st.store_id, st.store_name ORDER BY st.store_id ASC

SELECT o.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, o.order_type AS orderType, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paidOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refundOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.payable_amount), 0) AS payableAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'paid' THEN o.paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidAmount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'refunded' THEN o.paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundAmount FROM fit_order o LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.store_id = #{bo.storeId} AND o.create_time >= #{bo.startDate} AND o.create_time < DATE_ADD(#{bo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY o.store_id, st.store_name, o.order_type ORDER BY o.store_id ASC, o.order_type ASC

SELECT c.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, c.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, COUNT(DISTINCT s.schedule_id) AS scheduleCount, COUNT(DISTINCT r.reservation_id) AS reservationCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cr.checkin_status = 'success' AND cr.operator_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN cr.checkin_id END) AS checkinCount, IFNULL(ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cr.checkin_status = 'success' AND cr.operator_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN cr.checkin_id END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.reservation_id), 0), 2), 0) AS attendanceRate FROM fit_course c LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = c.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.course_id = c.course_id AND s.del_flag = '0' AND s.schedule_date >= #{bo.startDate} AND s.schedule_date < DATE_ADD(#{bo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) LEFT JOIN fit_course_reservation r ON r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.reservation_status <> 'cancelled' LEFT JOIN fit_checkin_record cr ON cr.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND cr.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.store_id = #{bo.storeId} GROUP BY c.store_id, st.store_name, c.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_type ORDER BY c.store_id ASC, c.course_id ASC

SELECT coach.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, coach.coach_id AS coachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.schedule_id) AS scheduleCount, COUNT(DISTINCT r.reservation_id) AS reservationCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cr.checkin_status = 'success' AND cr.operator_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN cr.checkin_id END) AS checkinCount, IFNULL(MAX(sales.privateCourseSalesAmount), 0) AS privateCourseSalesAmount FROM fit_coach coach LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = coach.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.coach_id = coach.coach_id AND s.del_flag = '0' AND s.schedule_date >= #{bo.startDate} AND s.schedule_date < DATE_ADD(#{bo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) LEFT JOIN fit_course_reservation r ON r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.reservation_status <> 'cancelled' LEFT JOIN fit_checkin_record cr ON cr.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND cr.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mc.store_id, mc.bind_coach_id AS coach_id, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS privateCourseSalesAmount FROM fit_member_card mc INNER JOIN fit_order o ON o.order_id = mc.order_id AND o.del_flag = '0' AND o.order_status = 'paid' WHERE mc.del_flag = '0' AND mc.bind_coach_id IS NOT NULL AND mc.plan_type = 'private_package' AND mc.store_id = #{bo.storeId} AND o.paid_time >= #{bo.startDate} AND o.paid_time < DATE_ADD(#{bo.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY mc.store_id, mc.bind_coach_id ) sales ON sales.store_id = coach.store_id AND sales.coach_id = coach.coach_id WHERE coach.del_flag = '0' AND coach.store_id = #{bo.storeId} GROUP BY coach.store_id, st.store_name, coach.coach_id, coach.coach_name ORDER BY coach.store_id ASC, coach.coach_id ASC
